SELECT t.out_driver_name AS driverName, t.out_driver_phone AS driverPhone, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.actual_checkin_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_checkin_time <= t.appointment_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTimeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.actual_checkin_time IS NULL OR t.actual_checkin_time > t.appointment_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN t.actual_checkin_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_checkin_time <= t.appointment_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1 ) AS onTimeRate FROM f_appointment_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND DATE(t.appointment_start) = #{appointmentDate}
AND t.out_driver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{driverName}, '%')
GROUP BY t.out_driver_name, t.out_driver_phone ORDER BY onTimeRate ASC
